description:
In this Video - Honda Cb350 insurance claim after accident | Honda cb350 chassis replacement | Honda Cb350 Damages after accident | Honda cb350 in service center after accident | Icici lombard bike insurance claim process |Honda cb350 insurance claim process | Honda cb350 repair after accident | Honda CB350 repair cost | Honda CB350 Major Accident | Heated argument with insurance agents | Claim insurance after bike accident | Icici lombard insurance claim process | My Honda CB350 Crashed | Honda highness 350 | Honda CB350 crashed in Highway | DeepSumi Vlogs


 #icicilombard #insuranceclaims #bikeaccdint  #accident #hondahighnesscb350 #hondacb350 #bike #mystory #bikerepair  #travelvlog #deepsumivlogs #cb350 #motovlog #ridinggears #2023

Hello Viewers, 
 
Todays video is not some regular travel vlog and I never wanted or expected to make this video but unfortunately in life things don't always go your way. Something very dramatic happened to us when were travelling from Kolkata to My hometown.

We met with a terrible accident and the most sad thing about this that it was not even our mistake.
So in this video I have explained everything that happened to us that day and even shared some important tips that could help you get away with something unfortunate like this or atleast help you prepare for unwanted incidents in future.
 My bike is with the service center right now and these are tough times for me so your support and love is what we need at this time.

I hope You will enjoy the Video. 

Thanks for Watching! 
DeepSumi Vlogs
